# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt

Compare branch-choice work with automation scanning when several next moves exist, including staying manual, becoming a skill, or becoming a playbook seed.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

The route needs explicit branch choices with costs, risks, and stop conditions.
Automation is only one possible branch, not yet the dominant classification
question.

## Expected object

A set of fork cards that compares manual, skill, and playbook-seed routes with stop conditions.

## Boundary notes

This is a session-route-forks case, not an automation-opportunity-scan case.

## Verification hooks

- include more than one materially different branch
- name owner targets and stop conditions
- avoid collapsing all branches into automation readiness
